# understudy-testo

Testo adapter for rasuvaeff/understudy (test double library: `when(fn () => $repo->find(123))->returns($book)`).

## Install

```bash
composer require --dev rasuvaeff/understudy-testo
```

## Rules

- Register the plugin per suite in `testo.php`: `plugins: [new UnderstudyPlugin()]`.
- `expect()` is ARMED BEFORE the run: it counts only calls that arrive after it is declared. A call that already happened is claimed retrospectively by `verify()` / read via `Understudy::calls()`.
- One expectation per call: `when()` and `expect()` on the same call do not compose (the later declaration takes the dispatch). Value + cardinality in one place: `expect(fn)->returns($v)` or `when(fn)->returns($v)->times(n)`.
- After a body that COMPLETED (`Passed`, `Flaky` or `Risky`) the adapter calls `Understudy::verifyAll()`; an unmet `expect()` fails the test.
- A test whose only check is an understudy expectation is not left `Risky`: the adapter takes that verdict back when its record is the only one in the history.
- After a FAILING/SKIPPED body nothing is verified — the original failure is never masked.
- The context is reset after EVERY test (`finally`); doubles never leak between tests.
- Verification adds exactly ONE to the `assertions` metric and appends one record to the collected `TestState`.
- That record is absent from the printed `assert-history` block: the collector renders it before this adapter runs.
- Doubles must be created in plain tests: `#[TestInline]` cases and benchmarks are never VERIFIED (nothing there is checked at the end).
- The RESET is unscoped: a double created in an inline case or a benchmark is dropped when it ends, so it cannot leak into the next test.
- `new UnderstudyPlugin(strictStubs: true)` additionally fails tests with unused stubs. Default: false.
- Fiber-local contexts come from core; the adapter adds no global state.
- Verification spans every context the test used, so a `#[RunInFiber]` body's expectations are checked too.

## testo.php

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Testo\UnderstudyPlugin;
use Testo\Application\Config\ApplicationConfig;
use Testo\Application\Config\SuiteConfig;

return new ApplicationConfig(
    src: ['src'],
    suites: [
        new SuiteConfig(name: 'Unit', location: ['tests'], plugins: [new UnderstudyPlugin()]),
    ],
);
```

## Typical test

```php
use function Rasuvaeff\Understudy\expect;
use Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Understudy;

$books = Understudy::for(BookRepository::class);
expect(static fn () => $books->find(7))->returns(new Book(7)); // exactly once, verified by the plugin

$service->charge(cart: [7]);
```

## API

| Member | Kind | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Testo\UnderstudyPlugin` | class | `PluginConfigurator`; constructor arg `bool $strictStubs = false` |
| `Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Testo\UnderstudyInterceptor` | class | `TestRunInterceptor`: verify-after-success, reset-in-finally |

All doubling operations live in the core package `rasuvaeff/understudy`
(`Understudy::for/when/expect/verify/calls/verifySequence/nothingElse/allVerified/
transcript/label/strict/forwarding/wire/defaults/bypassFinals/scope/checkpoint/reset`).
